title: SSE tree-update tab resync derives the tab list from the rendered nav.tabs (SSOT)
description: After the SSE tree-update swaps `#rcf-live-content` innerHTML, the newly-inserted panels carry the Phase 3.6 server-rendered default (one visible, the rest hidden). resyncTabsAfterSwap reads every [role="tab"][data-tab] under the surviving `nav.tabs`, finds the aria-selected button, and aligns `#tab-<name>` visibility so exactly the active tab is visible. The tab list is derived from the DOM rather than a parallel array in this file: before issue 297 the parallel array omitted 'readiness' and a swap while Readiness was active fell back to Overview with both panels visible. The overview fallback is kept only for a genuinely unknown or missing selection. Pairs with CN-744 and CN-745 (which this file also hosts) and with page-init.js's activateTab for the non-swap routing path (AC-18001-8).
